acceptance_criteria.description: The concrete provider runtime SDK and immutable image or template identity are pinned
Backend and execution capabilities are digest-bound with no provider-name fallback
Network artifact-export terminal-state and destroy receipts verify independently
Results remain exploratory until the standalone verifier closes the adapter boundary

objective: Bind a selected remote sandbox provider through the digest-bound backend capability chain with observed network, export, teardown, and recovery evidence.
title: Implement the next remote sandbox backend adapter
